purpose: Protect live 3B TRUE God training job. Never interrupt, overwrite, corrupt, starve, restart, pause, move, or optimize it from automation.
forbiddenActions: kill/pkill/killall targeting train PID or train python
az vm stop/deallocate/restart/delete of train host
GPU merge/export with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES non-empty on train host
starting competing train on same GPU while status=running-do-not-interrupt
deleting sole live checkpoint / wiping train run root
allowedWithCpuOnlyGuard: stage checkpoint file copy to export-staging
CPU merge/export with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty (never on train GPU)
